cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the system checks people by biometrics. The OeSD concession that was to bring deduplication was unratified, and the House endorsed a report recommending its rejection in November 2026.
cells.note: Stage 3: the registry held about 740,000 records on the Techno Brain system in November 2026 (LBR-029, LBR-031), and cards are issued in Monrovia. No source shows biometric deduplication running, so stage 4 is not met.
